```sql
SELECT
    CASE 
        WHEN balls_faced = 0 THEN 0
        ELSE (total_runs::numeric / balls_faced) * 100
    END AS strike_rate
FROM (
    SELECT
        SUM(d.batter_runs) AS total_runs,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE d.extras_type IS NULL 
               OR d.extras_type NOT IN ('wides', 'no_ball')
        ) AS balls_faced
    FROM deliveries d
    JOIN matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE m.season = 2016
      AND d.batter = 'V Kohli'
) AS stats;
```
